_note: Real Journal Impact Factors (Clarivate JCR) for the journal-impact scatter. Key by ISSN-L (preferred) or by journal name; value is the JIF as a number. Any journal listed here is plotted with that value instead of the OpenAlex 2-year mean citedness, and if this file is non-empty the figures relabel the x axis 'Journal impact factor'. JCR is licensed, so it cannot be pulled automatically; paste the values in by hand.
